Mathlib has no line integral of a Kähler differential along a path on the space of places. The current proof applies a single declaration, `AlgebraicCurve.pathIntegral_finset_sum_smul`, but that belongs to the library, not to Mathlib. The content is linearity of this library-defined path integral, so it cannot be a special case of a Mathlib declaration either. I checked this from the definitions named in the statement and did not run a separate grep of the Mathlib sources.
